proposals.hypothesis: Journeys affected: browse, cart, checkout. Degradation: Temporary spike in errors (>5%) for first 5 seconds, then rapid recovery to baseline error rate within 10 seconds. Graceful behavior: System recovers quickly without user impact due to stateless catalog data.
proposals.reason: Critical service used in 3 journeys; pod-kill tests self-healing capability (untested) while service-down (tested) confirms criticality. 10s duration balances impact and recovery.

proposals.hypothesis: Journeys affected: cart, checkout. Degradation: Cart journey latency increases (>50ms), checkout journey times out (error rate >10%). Graceful behavior: Cart service timeout (1s) prevents checkout hangs.
proposals.reason: Critical service for cart/checkout; network-delay untested despite service-down/pod-kill results. 500ms delay simulates real-world latency impact on stateful service (uses redis-cart).

proposals.hypothesis: Journeys affected: checkout. Degradation: Checkout latency increases (>100ms), error rate rises (>20%). Graceful behavior: Checkout service timeout (5s) avoids prolonged hangs.
